Subject: POC prompt dataset + evaluation plan — AcmeCorp

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the deep dive. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned on the POC scope and what we need from Acme to get started:

High-level POC goal
- Validate Redwood’s prompt-handling and hallucination rate vs your current service for the customer support summarization workflow.

Success criteria (proposed)
- Intent match rate >= 90% on the 10k-sample prompt set
- Critical hallucination rate < 2% (as defined in doc attached)
- Median generation latency <= 350ms for 512-token responses under P50 load

Evaluation plan (what we'll run)
1) You provide: representative prompt set (and anonymized logs) + expected output examples where available.
2) Redwood will: ingest dataset, run baseline model and two tuned variants, compute automated metrics (intent match, ROUGE/EM where applicable), and run a small human review (50 samples) for hallucination grading.
3) Joint review: we’ll share results, discuss tradeoffs, and recommend quantization/serving config for production.

Timeline
- Please share sample prompts and anonymized logs by EOD Fri 2/27
- Ingest + initial runs: 3 business days after we receive data (target week of 3/2)
- Joint review call: within 48h of initial run results

Ownership
- Customer: Samantha (business KPIs) and Luke (technical contact/owner for logs and access)
- Redwood: Marissa (PM/sales), Aditya (technical lead), Dev (implementation)

Attachments
- poc_eval_template.xlsx (template for prompt/sample metadata and expected output) — please fill out columns marked ‘required’ and include an example row.

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above or propose adjustments, and share 200-500 sample prompts + anonymized logs by 2/27? Also let us know preferred time for a 30m kickoff next week (I’m proposing Thu 2/26 11:30am PT).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
